text:
Ana P: Ran into dup requests in sampleapp when auth refresh races with retries. Repro is tiny.

Ana P: Sequence:
1) client sends job -> 429
2) SDK kicks in retry backoff immediately
3) meanwhile refresh flow completes and original request is replayed -> server processed twice

Ravi D: Do we attach any stable id to the logical operation? If not, server can't dedupe.

Jordan H: Node had a local fix that cancels pending retry when refresh starts but Go and Python keep retrying. Parity pain.

Ana P: Quick patch idea: always add header `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` at request creation and reuse for retries. Also add middleware to detect auth refresh in-flight and increase retry delay by estimated refresh time.

Ravi D: For onboarding sampleapp we should expose `safeReplay: true` so devs see recommended behavior. Docs should show server-side dedupe example.

Jordan H: What about jitter tuning? Current uniform jitter sometimes causes retries to land before refresh finishes. Maybe use payload-aware jitter: base_ms * sqrt(payload_kb) * uniform(0.6..1.4). Keeps small requests fast.

Ana P: Agreed. Also add a tiny retry budget: if refresh started, only allow 1 backoff attempt before switching to long-delay. Prevents hammering during refresh storms.

Ravi D: Will centralizing this as a 'SafeReplay' middleware in sdk-core work? Then each language SDK can opt in and share tests.

Ana P: Yes. Middleware responsibilities: generate/persist idempotency header, introspect auth state (refresh in-flight), amend jitter, enforce budget. Keep config surface minimal: {safeReplay: boolean, baseJitterMs: number, replayBudget: number}.

Jordan H: Add e2e test that simulates: 429 -> refresh takes 400ms -> verify only one payload accepted server-side when idempotency header set.

devex-bot: (automated) Filed DEVTICKET-499: "SafeReplay middleware + idempotency header + adaptive jitter + e2e auth-race tests".

Ana P: I'll prototype Node middleware and a sampleapp demo with server dedupe snippet:
```
app.post('/v1/generate', (req, res) => {
  const key = req.header('Idempotency-Key');
  if (processedKeys.has(key)) return res.status(200).send({status: 'duplicate'});
  processedKeys.add(key);
  // handle normally
});
```

Ravi D: I'll work Python SDK tests + spec. Jordan please coordinate on how Go currently treats auth-race.

Jordan H: On it. Also adding a short paragraph to SDK sync notes about conservativeReplay mode for tutorials so engineers onboarding with sampleapp don't get surprised.

Ana P: thx all. Will ping when PR is up. :)
